description:
A tiny, fast, private PDF viewer. No ads, no accounts, no telemetry.

No Bloat PDF is a free PDF viewer for Windows built for one job: opening
documents instantly. A 4.6 MB installer delivers tabs for multiple
documents, full text search, thumbnails and bookmarks, dark mode, high
resolution printing, and highlighting and annotations, rendered by
Mozilla's pdf.js engine in a lightweight native shell. Pages can be
deleted, reordered, copied, and exported from the Pages panel and saved
back into the PDF. Signatures can be typed, drawn, or uploaded, and up to
five saved for reuse. Sanitize Document rebuilds a file from scratch so
the author name, metadata, scripts, and prior revisions are genuinely
removed rather than merely hidden. It makes zero network calls: no
telemetry, no accounts, no cloud, no upsells.
Bug fix: clicking a web link inside a PDF opened the website inside the
app window and took over the viewer until the app was forced closed.
Links in documents now open in the default browser, and the viewer
window can no longer navigate away from the app.
